ACKNOWLEDGED
5 / V / 1933

CANADIAN PACIFIC
STEAMSHIPS - HOTELS - RAILWAYS - EXPRESS

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D H 8038
Date 28 / 5 / 1933

SHANGHAI:

BANKS, HOTELS, TOURIST AGENCIES
& POLICE.

Dear Sirs,

Canadian Pacific Express Travellers' Cheques
Nos. 248449 to 248454 inclusive of $50.00 denomination
" 82756 to 82760 " " $100.00 "

Under date 24th March 1933, Mr. John Blackhall, Treasurer of
the Canadian Pacific Express Co., Toronto, advises that the above-
mentioned Travellers Cheques were secured by Mrs. William Fortune
at Washington, D.C., on March 22nd, by means of forged bank draft.

Will you kindly have a special watch kept for the cheques
in question, notifying the undersigned immediately should any of
them be presented to you for payment.

Yours truly,

A. W. Metcalfe
AGENT

多伦多加拿大太平洋快递公司司库约翰·布莱克霍尔（John Blackhall）先生于1933年3月24日函告，上述旅行支票系威廉·福琼（William Fortune）夫人于3月22日在华盛顿特区通过伪造银行汇票骗取。

恳请贵方对上述支票予以特别监控，若有人向贵方提示兑付其中任何一张支票，请立即通知具名签署人。

此致

A. W. 梅特卡夫（A. W. Metcalfe）
代理人

CANADIAN PACIFIC EXPRESS COMPANY
Office of the Treasurer

88 Simcoe Street,
TORONTO, CANADA

March 28th, 1933

WARNING
======

BE ON THE WATCH FOR WILLIAM
FORTUNE ALIAS DR. ORNALDO DE BEST, ET AL AND HIS
ALLEGED WIFE THEA
------

We issued a warning circular on Jan. 12th, 1933, as follows:-

"During 1932 Fortune defrauded several companies in Germany, the
United States, Canada and on board Trans-Atlantic Liners by
means of counterfeit Bank Notes and fraudulent Cheques.
He arrived in Halifax, N.S., Dec. 10th, 1932, accompanied by his
wife named Thea and a three month old child. At that point he
succeeded in passing at least one worthless cheque for $100.00.
Fortune is in possession of Canadian passport No. 119574, issued
Ottawa, January 16th, 1931, also under the name of Ornaldo De
Best and a passport of the Republic of Santa Dominica.
His description is as follows: Age 23 years, height 5' 11",
weight 210 lbs., swarthy complexion, black hair, brown eyes,
Hebrew appearance, dragon tattooed on chest, wears good clothes
and usually a bowler hat. His wife is apparently of German
extraction, age 20 years, 5' 4", blue eyes, fair hair, stout,
good looking."

These people obtained two different lots of Travellers' Cheques for
$800.00 each in Washington, D.C., U.S.A., on March 22nd, 1933, from
Steamship Sub-Agents BY MEANS OF FRAUDULENT BANK CHEQUES.

The description above is confirmed with the exception that the age
of Fortune is now given as 34 years, however because of his weight a
mistake might easily be made in his age.

The Fortunes are dangerous International Crooks with many aliases. They
are apt to visit your Office or your Sub-Agents at any time.

Putting over Forged Certified Cheques and Fraudulent Bank Drafts is an
old game with a certain class of crooks. Agents must not under any
circumstances accept Certified Cheques or Bank Drafts FROM STRANGERS in
payment for financial paper without first having them identified AND THEN

司库办公室

加拿大多伦多
西姆科街88号

1933年3月28日

警告
======

注意通缉威廉·福琼（WILLIAM FORTUNE），化名奥纳尔多·德·贝斯特博士（DR. ORNALDO DE BEST）等人，及其所谓妻子西娅（THEA）
------

我方曾于1933年1月12日发布如下警告通告：-

“1932年间，福琼在德国、美国、加拿大以及跨大西洋班轮上，利用假钞和欺诈性支票诈骗多家公司。他于1932年12月10日抵达新斯科舍省哈利法克斯，随行有其名为西娅的妻子及一名三个月大的婴儿。在该地，他成功兑现至少一张面值100.00美元的空头支票。福琼持有1931年1月16日渥太华签发的加拿大护照，号码119574，亦使用奥纳尔多·德·贝斯特（Ornaldo De Best）之名，并持有一本圣多明各共和国护照。其体貌特征如下：年龄23岁，身高5英尺11英寸，体重210磅，肤色黝黑，黑发，褐眼，具有希伯来人相貌，胸部纹有龙形纹身，衣着考究，通常戴圆顶硬礼帽。其妻显然为德国裔，年龄20岁，身高5英尺4英寸，蓝眼，金发，体态丰满，容貌姣好。”

这些人于1933年3月22日在美国华盛顿特区，通过轮船子代理处，利用欺诈性银行支票骗取了两批旅行支票，每批价值800.00美元。

上述体貌描述经确认无误，唯福琼的年龄现报为34岁，但因其体重较大，年龄极易被误判。

福琼夫妇是危险的国际罪犯，拥有多个化名。他们可能随时造访贵办事处或贵方子代理处。

使用伪造保付支票和欺诈性银行汇票是某类罪犯的老伎俩。在任何情况下，代理人不得接受陌生人用于支付金融票据的保付支票或银行汇票，除非先核实其身份，随后

COMMUNICATING WITH THE BANK TO MAKE SURE THAT THE ACCEPTANCE STAMP
OR DRAFT IS GENUINE AND THAT THE AMOUNT OF THE CHEQUE HAS NOT BEEN
RAISED.

Keep this circular prominently before you and if they present them-
selves at your office or you learn anything of their whereabouts
endeavour to detain them on some pretext or other and advise the
local Police that Fortune is wanted by the New York police - Wire
full particulars to your Superintendent and to the undersigned.

JOHN BLACKALL

Treasurer

请将本通告置于显眼处。若他们出现在贵办事处，或贵方获悉其行踪，请设法以某种借口将其扣留，并告知当地警方纽约警方正在通缉福琼——将详细情况电告贵方督察长及具名签署人。

约翰·布莱克霍尔（JOHN BLACKALL）
